access_denied.message: Access to the local daemon was denied. Check endpoint ownership and user permissions; do not run the app as administrator.

already_running.message: A daemon or another process already owns this endpoint. Retry connecting; no running process was replaced.

bridge_unavailable.message: The native desktop bridge is unavailable. Open the Tauri application rather than the Vite page in a browser.

disconnected.message: The daemon connection closed. Your local UI state is retained; retry after restarting the daemon.

incompatible.message: The running daemon uses an incompatible protocol or lacks required capabilities. Update matching binaries; it will not be replaced automatically.

invalid_message.message: The daemon sent an invalid control message. Check that desktop and daemon versions match.

slow_consumer.message: The desktop stopped acknowledging frames. The bounded subscription was closed; retry to receive the latest state.

start_failed.message: The daemon could not start. Build or install matrix-daemon alongside the desktop executable, then retry.

timed_out.message: The daemon did not respond in time. Check its health, then retry.

unavailable.message: No daemon is listening. Start the daemon or retry the connection.
